which record: *** The 1903 baptism. *** San Juan Bautista, Pocitos, Montevideo, folio 344, 15 August 1903. Film 007713400 image 02828; ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-R346-Z.
what it says, from the image: Heading: *** "Maria Zalduondo" ***. "El quince de Agosto de Mil Novecientos tres; yo el infrascrito bautice solemnemente a *** MARIA MARGARITA LUISA ***, que nacio el veintiuno de Junio de este ano; hija legitima de *** EDUARDO ZALDUONDO *** y *** AMELIA LERENA ***, orientales. Abuelos paternos: *** JUAN *** y *** DOLORES POU DE ZALDUONDO ***. Abuelos maternos: *** AVELINO *** y *** CELIDONIA B. DE LERENA ***. Fueron padrinos *** ADOLFO LERENA *** y *** MARIA ANGELICA YUBIA ***."
what it settles: Kills ZALSAMENDI. Gives the child her fourth name, *** LUISA ***. And its maternal grandparents - *** AVELINO and CELIDONIA B. de LERENA *** - are *** AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL and CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS ***, which is what joins this household to the Lerena Villademoros and so to the Lerena Traibel.

which record: *** The 1913 death act. *** Montevideo, certificate 553, 22 August 1913. DGS 008165206 image 283; ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2C-2DNF.
what it says, from the image: "Ha fallecido *** EDUARDO ZALDUANDO ***, del sexo masculino, de nacionalidad oriental, *** NACIDO EN MONTEVIDEO ***, de *** cincuenta y dos anos *** de edad, de estado casado y de profesion *** JUBILADO ***, a consecuencia de *** ANGINA DE PECHO ***, segun consta del certificado del Dr. *** BORDONI POSSE ***. Que el finado era hijo de *** JUAN ZALDUONDO *** y de *** DOLORES POU, FALLECIDOS ***." At seven in the morning, at *** calle JUAN B. BLANCO 9 ***. Declared by *** AGUSTIN AGNESE ***, 28, and *** CONRADO P. ABAL ***, 22, before the Juez de Paz *** EDUARDO J. MORATORIO ***.
what it settles: Confirms the surname and both parents from a second hand ten years later, and *** ADDS A BIRTHPLACE (MONTEVIDEO), A CAUSE OF DEATH, AN ADDRESS AND A PENSION ***. "Jubilado" at fifty-two means a salaried career this archive has not looked for. *** AND IT KILLS THE IDEA THAT HIS PARENTS COULD STILL BE TRACED ALIVE *** - both were dead by 1913.

which record: *** The sentence that settles the wife. *** Same act, the closing clause.
what it says, from the image: "Asi mismo se hace constar que era casado con *** ANGELICA LERENA ***, de cuya union quedan *** TRES HIJOS *** llamados: *** MARIA ELENA, EDUARDO AVELINO y MARIA MARGARITA ***."
what it settles: *** ONE CHILD CANNOT BE INSIDE TWO DIFFERENT UNIONS. *** The 1903 act makes Maria Margarita the daughter of AMELIA; this act makes her one of three children of the union with ANGELICA. So *** AMELIA AND ANGELICA ARE ONE WOMAN *** and the sisters-theory is refused by the record itself. *** AND THERE ARE THREE CHILDREN, NOT TWO: MARIA ELENA IS NEW. ***

which record: *** The forename, which is NOT explained - only outvoted. *** Three documents, two names.
what it says, from the image: Her baptism of 1872 says *** ANGELICA MARIA ***. The 1913 death act says *** ANGELICA ***. Only the 1903 priest wrote *** AMELIA ***, and he wrote it clearly - it was checked at high magnification precisely because it was inconvenient.
what it settles: *** TWO TO ONE IS NOT AN EXPLANATION. *** This archive does not know why a priest wrote Amelia, and says so. The name is kept as a recorded variant on her row rather than erased, because a reader meeting "Amelia Lerena" in the Pocitos register must be able to find her here.

which record: *** The marriage, found the same day the question was filed. *** Montevideo, 4a seccion, civil act *** No. 83 of 20 NOVEMBER 1897 ***, folio 42, at five in the afternoon, before the Juez de Paz *** GALLO PAREJA ***; the marriage itself in expediente No. 94. Image ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2W-N35B-M; index ark 1:1:XS6K-MYFD.
what it says, from the image: *** EDUARDO ZALDUONDO ***, empleado, oriental, *** 'nacido el dia QUINCE de AGOSTO de mil ochocientos SESENTA en esta Ciudad' ***, of calle Convencion 226; son of *** JUAN ZALDUONDO, 80, jubilado, ORIENTAL *** and *** DOLORES POU, 58, BRASILENA ***. And *** DONA ANGELICA LORENA [LERENA] ***, oriental, *** 'nacida el dia OCHO de ABRIL de mil ochocientos SETENTA Y UNO' ***, of *** Plaza Libertad No. 9 ***; daughter of *** DON AVELINO, oriental, 'FALLECIDO EN CANELONES EN EL ANO DE 1895' ***, and *** DONA CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, 55, VIUDA, ARGENTINA ***. Witnesses *** FERNANDO MORATORIO ***, 50, comercio, calle Uruguay 97, and *** AGUSTIN RIVA ***, 38, empleado, calle Sarandi 166. The *** 'Legitiman' line is BLANK ***. *** SHE SIGNED IT HERSELF: 'Angelica Lerena'. ***
what it settles: *** THIS ONE ACT ANSWERS FOUR THINGS AT ONCE. *** (1) *** THE MARRIAGE *** - work-list row 186 can close. (2) *** AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA TRAIBEL DIED IN CANELONES IN 1895 ***, a death this archive did not have - and it makes the withdrawn “La Paz, Canelones” reading look like a CONFUSION OF FATHER WITH SON rather than an invention, while leaving that retraction standing, since his father died at Montevideo in 1890 and nothing here says La Paz. (3) *** THE ZALDUONDO PARENTS ARE NOT SPANISH IMMIGRANTS *** - Juan is ORIENTAL and Dolores is BRAZILIAN, against a row that had reasoned 'Catalan or Balearic' from her surname. (4) *** THE BLANK 'LEGITIMAN' LINE puts all three children after November 1897 ***, which excludes Maria Elena Zalduondo from being the Maria Elena Lerena who married in 1906 - a pair this register had been unable to decide. *** AN EMPTY FIELD DID THAT. ***
